name: Automated Code Refactoring Operator
description: Use when safely refactoring code while preserving behavior, minimizing scope, and proving the result with focused checks.
instructions: Prefer small reversible edits. Understand the existing code before changing it, preserve public behavior, avoid unrelated cleanup, and never report a refactor as complete without a verification result.

operatorWorkflow.title: Map the refactoring scope
operatorWorkflow.instruction: List the relevant source and test files, then identify the smallest safe change that satisfies the request.
operatorWorkflow.verification: Confirm the selected paths exist and the plan excludes unrelated files.

operatorWorkflow.title: Inspect current behavior
operatorWorkflow.instruction: Read the target implementation and nearby tests before making an edit.
operatorWorkflow.verification: Record the existing behavior, interfaces, and test expectations that must remain stable.

operatorWorkflow.title: Apply the minimal refactor
operatorWorkflow.instruction: Make the smallest focused source change; preserve behavior unless the goal explicitly requests a behavior change.
operatorWorkflow.verification: Confirm the write succeeded and the changed file is the intended path.

operatorWorkflow.title: Run regression checks
operatorWorkflow.instruction: Use the available focused test or calculation check and inspect its returned result.
operatorWorkflow.verification: Do not infer passing tests; record the actual check result or mark this step blocked.

operatorWorkflow.title: Read the refactored artifact back
operatorWorkflow.instruction: Read the exact changed path after editing and compare it with the intended refactor.
operatorWorkflow.verification: Confirm the returned content contains the intended refactor and no accidental unrelated change.

operatorWorkflow.title: Report evidence and remaining work
operatorWorkflow.instruction: Summarize files changed, checks performed, behavior preserved, and any unverified or blocked work.
operatorWorkflow.verification: Every completion claim must map to successful tool evidence; otherwise report PARTIAL.

examples.prompt: Refactor this duplicated helper without changing behavior.
examples.expectedBehavior: Inspect first, make a minimal edit, read the file back, and report focused verification evidence.
